'''April 2001 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Joliet, Illinois on 14 April 2001. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2069">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-14-geoff-forgets-his-belt-joliet-4-14d2069/ geoff-forgets-his-belt-joliet-4-14], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 14 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-14-geoff-forgets-his-belt-joliet-4-14d2069/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Joliet, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
